name: Heartstring Bugs
source: After having a disappointing first year of high school, Elly wants to open herself up to other people. A chance encounter with a baby virus grants her the ability to see emotions of other people, which also gives her an extra boost of confidence. Raise Elly's stats and watch the events unfold!
translation: 在度过了令人失望的高中一年级后，艾莉想向其他人敞开心扉。一次偶然的机会接触到婴儿病毒，让她能够看到别人的情绪，这也让她信心倍增。提高艾莉的统计数据并观看事件的展开！
